Privacy

Hosting and contact

Person responsible: Mag. Dr. Thomas Jäger. Contact: thomas.ralf.jaeger@univie.ac.at; full postal address in the legal notice.

This website is hosted using GitHub Pages. GitHub documents that visitors’ IP addresses are logged and stored for security purposes, regardless of whether visitors are signed in to GitHub.

GitHub Pages · GitHub Privacy Statement

Planner answers

The website application does not transmit your planning answers to a server. The strategy, database and workshop planners use this tab’s session storage. Selected Antipattern Academy progress may remain in local browser storage; the learning activity describes how to clear it. Creating a workshop package retrieves the selected resource files from this website. External sources are visited when their links are opened. The application embeds no tracking services or externally loaded fonts.
